scope: Four-update one-toggle EDCS variant witness, parameterized star construction, repair lower-bound claims, and original-EDCS novelty boundary.

corrected_overbroad_claim.claim: Every P2-deficient unused edge must be inserted into H.

counterexample.post_update: insert e; d_H(x)=0, d_H(v)=1 and e is P2-deficient

corrected_overbroad_claim.missing_assumption: A statement forcing e itself requires a restricted one-toggle model plus beta_minus=beta-1 and the stated degree-zero/private-endpoint conditions; it is not true for arbitrary beta_minus or arbitrary multi-toggle repairs.

corrected_single_toggle_lemma.status: fully proved for the explicitly stated model
assumptions: e is the only G-edge incident to x
adding e creates an existing used-edge P1 violation
repair may perform exactly one insertion or deletion of one H edge
corrected_single_toggle_lemma.conclusion: No one-toggle post-update state can satisfy both P1 and P2.
corrected_single_toggle_lemma.proof_obligation: Deletion cannot increase e's degree sum; a different inserted edge was P2-valid before the external update and receives a +2 sum, hence violates P1; inserting e is assumed to create P1 violation.

parameterized_star.status: fully proved for every integer beta>=3 with beta_minus=beta-1
parameterized_star.construction: A star of beta-1 edges at a followed by (x,v1).

all_single_toggle_outcomes.delete_used_edge: P2 remains false for the cross edge
all_single_toggle_outcomes.insert_other_unused_edge: its pre-update P2 sum was >= beta-1 and becomes >= beta+1, so P1 fails
all_single_toggle_outcomes.insert_edge_at_x: impossible because x has no other incident G-edge

parameterized_star.interpretation: Minimum two single-edge toggles for this sparse witness; not a general dynamic-maintenance complexity lower bound.

claim_classification.classification: fully proved for restricted one-toggle model

claim_classification.claim: two-toggle minimum in the stated family
claim_classification.classification: fully proved conditional repair lower bound

claim_classification.claim: alternating EDCS repairs and bounded repair work
general dynamic EDCS maintenance lower bound

prior_art_boundary: Bernstein-Stein already use alternating full/deficient repair paths and bound repair work; later HEDCS and dynamic-matching papers use related maintenance/verification ideas. No original-EDCS theorem or general lower bound is claimed.
paper3_boundary: Target A direct resolution and Target B evidence growth remain separate and unscored; missing outcomes are not negative labels.
paper4_boundary: The EDCS action reduced uncertainty about the tested variant, but one action cannot validate planner superiority.

next_experiment.question: Does the obstruction depend on beta_minus=beta-1, the one-toggle budget, or queue policy?
next_experiment.protocol: Compare beta_minus gaps, one-toggle versus two-toggle repairs, and new-edge-first versus FIFO priority on the same formal state family.
